title: All At One Point (Miniature V for solo marimba)
program_note:
Miniature V:  All At One Point was originally written as a solo work between September and October, 1992.  Like the other works in the Miniatures series, it takes as its starting point and as its inspiration the unique sonic and technical qualities of the instrument.  Here, the way a note two octaves above that of a particular bar can be brought out by striking at the node is exploited.

In some respects the musical material is related to a short story in Italo Calvino’s Cosmicomics entitled “All At One Point,” especially the use of pedal points which become gradually destabilized or which slowly bloom into full chords or lines.

The piece is between 7’30” and 8” long, if played up to the tempo marked.

David S. Lefkowitz

4 October 1993

Rochester, NY
